purpose: Build StreetVerse Chicago from authorized geographic/open data while keeping visual-reference sources separate from distributable game assets.

communityAreaDefinition.source: City of Chicago / official community-area framework
communityAreaDefinition.use: canonical community-area IDs/names and source-backed boundary ingestion

geometrySources.name: OpenStreetMap
use: building/POI experiments where license obligations are satisfied

transitSources.name: CTA / GTFS or other authorized transit feeds

visualReferenceSources.name: Google Street View
visualReferenceSources.permittedProjectUse: human visual QA/reference for streetscape proportions, facade types, street furniture, tree placement patterns and neighborhood character
notFor: training a StreetVerse asset model from imagery
shipping imagery as a game asset
visualReferenceSources.note: A separately approved Google Maps Platform integration may have its own terms and attribution requirements; reference-only is the default StreetVerse rule.

buildRule: Geometry/data and visual reference are separate lanes. A neighborhood may not be called source-certified until geography, provenance, collision, navigation, mobile performance and visual QA gates pass.
